svg.title: Potentiometer threshold and LED relay logical circuit
svg.desc: Board 3V3 powers a 10k potentiometer. Wiper through 15k to GPIO35 with 10k and 100 nF to ground. GPIO19 and a 10k pull-down command active-HIGH STEMMA 4409, separately powered at 5 V. COM and NO switch only a separate 3 V battery LED circuit.
